method: Source tracing, generated HTML and pure-function/catalog reproduction. No live UI.

findings.title: Catalog return loses Static or Dynamic category
findings.task: Return from a profile or comparison to category-filtered results
findings.evidence: Category exists in pathname but context captures form fields only; CATALOG_FILTERS excludes mode and catalogHref always returns root. catalogHref('/ToolWiki', [], 'language=C%2B%2B&mode=Static') returns '/ToolWiki/?language=C%2B%2B'. Static/C++ has 15 entries versus All/C++24.
findings.impact: Explicit return silently broadens results and loses selection context.
findings.recommendation: Add allowlisted category context and map it to local catalog routes; retain offsite/nested context protection.
acceptance: All/Static/Dynamic round-trip through profiles and comparisons retaining query, filters, sort and selections
Unknown category defaults to All; no arbitrary redirects
findings.compatibility: Additive URL context; no v1 system-format changes.

findings.title: Edition comparison hides source when note is absent
findings.task: Follow evidence beside Polyspace edition comparison
findings.evidence: note and source are independently optional, but note gates rendering of both. Polyspace supplies a Required products and platforms source without a note; generated comparison omits it. General profile Sources still contains URL.
findings.impact: Valid contextual citation metadata is ignored; claim is not wholly uncited.
findings.recommendation: Render when either exists and render note/source independently.
acceptance: Source-only, note-only, both and neither behave correctly
Polyspace contextual source appears without invented note

findings.title: Project purpose-specific browser data from shared metadata
findings.task: Expand profile depth without inflating unrelated browser data
findings.evidence: Three transformations spread full tool records. Catalog JSON 252211 uncompressed bytes; consumed-field projection 48257 bytes; workflow arrays75190 bytes. No latency benchmark performed.
findings.impact: Content growth inflates catalog payload and repeated adapters can drift.
findings.recommendation: Use one build-time adapter with explicit catalog/comparison/matching projections; Markdown remains authoritative.
acceptance: Other surfaces retain consumed fields and draft filtering
Report size change without claiming measured speedup
findings.compatibility: Internal generated data; preserve URLs and v1 imports.

findings.title: Consolidate identical controlled vocabularies
findings.task: Add supported categories without schema drift
findings.evidence: Nine input values duplicated between metadata validation and INPUTS; cost/license values repeat; editionGroup enum not type-linked to comparison keys. Current lists agree.
findings.impact: Future changes require synchronized edits and can create metadata/workflow incompatibility.
findings.recommendation: Share identical input/cost/license choices and derive edition validation from typed comparison keys; keep preference-only sentinels separate.
acceptance: Existing v1 serialized values remain valid
findings.compatibility: No serialized-value renames or removals without migration.

findings.title: Make featured comparisons explicit
findings.task: Add comparison guidance without changing unrelated promoted choices
findings.evidence: Starting comparisons selected by indexes[0,1,3,4,6]. Insertions/reordering silently change promotion; current checks validate links/tools but not membership.
findings.impact: Array ordering becomes hidden navigation configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add featured boolean while retaining authored order.
acceptance: Adding unfeatured relationship does not change promotions

rejected_leads: Initial Pagefind PermissionDenied and missing sitemap resolved by normal-permission rebuild; environment limitation, not product defect.
